Hi! My name is Renata Kenzhebulatova. I am studying for a BA in Graphic Design at the British Higher School of Art and Design. I have also completed a year-long Motion Design and CG course at Bang Bang Education.
С каждым годом я стараюсь развивать свои: Every year, I develop my skills across illustration, typography, layout, identity and animation. Working on a wide range of projects helps me keep exploring and growing creatively.
Люблю работать как в команде, так и само: I enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. I like exploring the technical and creative sides of different disciplines in depth and continually improving my skills.
Работаю с инструментами для анимации (Ci: I use Cinema 4D and After Effects for animation; Photoshop, Illustrator and Affinity Designer for illustration and graphics; Blender for 3D scenes and objects; and InDesign for layout.
Работаю с 2D и 3D-графикой: создаю анима:
I work with 2D and 3D graphics, creating animation, illustration and visual effects in a range of formats. I develop projects from the initial idea to the final outcome, including concept, design and production.

I am confident with several professional tools and choose them to suit each project, from static graphics to animation and 3D.
Разрабатываю айдентику от идеи до полной:
I develop identities from concept to completion, from key visuals and headlines to merchandise and communication.

I create cohesive visual systems and adapt them to different formats, including animation, banners and digital communication.
Опыт верстки печатных и цифровых формато:
I design layouts for print and digital formats, working with text, composition, typography and graphics.

I develop books, booklets and zines from the initial idea to final production.
В рамках проекта я разработала айдентику: For this project, I developed an identity for Kendrick Lamar’s song “United in Grief”, exploring how abstract shapes can visualise sound. The aim was to convey the mood and dynamics of the track through colour, movement and composition.
Визуальная система проекта строится на с: The visual system combines gradients, fluid shapes and rhythmic elements to evoke a continuous flow of sound. Animation, posters, social media announcements and merchandise all share the same visual concept.
С самого начала работы мне было\nважно п: From the outset, I wanted to build the project’s visual language around colour and transitions of light, which I associated with the sound of the track. I explored the interplay of abstract shapes, gradients and motion to convey the rhythm and emotional character of the music.
Постепенно отдельные элементы\nсложились: The individual elements gradually came together as a cohesive identity that works across digital animation, social media, print and merchandise.

Проект посвящён разработке айдентики для: This team project focused on developing an identity for Universal University’s Degree Show 2026. We created a visual system that reflects the event’s concept and brings its different disciplines into a unified communication. Our main focus was a flexible visual language that could adapt to different applications and formats.
Главное УТП и слоган UU - рушит правила,: UU’s core promise and slogan: breaking rules and teaching new ways of thinking — “think outside the box”.
Как университет дает фундамент и задает: How the university provides a foundation and sets a direction for the future.
Гармонично объединяет огромное количеств: Bringing a diverse community and its interests together in harmony.
При разработке носителей мы старались со: Across all applications, we aimed to preserve a visual principle that could adapt to different formats. On posters, animations and other materials, the shapes change in scale and colour to make the system varied and flexible. This gives the identity a dynamic quality and lets it respond to different compositions. Patterns, typography and the isometric grid keep it recognisable, cohesive and informative throughout.
В анимации фигуры двигаются по сетке, чт: In the animation, shapes move along the grid, suggesting motion, freedom and the possibility of growing in any direction. Although the compositions change, every element remains part of a shared structure.
В результате нам удалось создать систему: The result is a system that connects the different disciplines within Degree Show 2026 while allowing the student work to remain the focus. We wanted the graphic language to become part of the exhibition, helping projects, spaces and audiences communicate with one another.
Этот креативный проект был командной раб: This collaborative project explores arches in the Gagarinsky District and offers our interpretation of them. I wanted to see arches as something alive, with an inner character of their own. The concept rests on the contrast between exterior and interior space. From the outside, an arch is a simple, familiar structure that people pass through without a second thought. I imagined something hidden beyond that visible surface: an inner world shaped by the people who live nearby or walk through it every day.
